interpretations.headline: System pressure is being shaped by effective capacity, not physical beds alone.
interpretations.what_changed: Network occupancy remains above the watch threshold after applying staffed/effective bed constraints.
interpretations.likely_drivers: Respiratory activity, ED placement pressure, discharge barriers, and aggregate HR gap hours are moving together.
interpretations.review_action: Use this as a huddle prioritization cue: confirm the highest-pressure units, ask whether barriers can be moved today, and check whether any scenario is feasible under HR and resource limits.
interpretations.confidence_reason: Direct synthetic capacity and staffing variables are ready; public-context and finance-resource variables remain review-grade.
interpretations.next_step: Open the inpatient object list and compare action feasibility in the scenario lab.

interpretations.headline: Open-context variables are forecast-shaping, but should stay visibly separable from operational feeds.
interpretations.what_changed: Current respiratory index is 0.474 and AQHI/smoke proxy is 4.94.
interpretations.likely_drivers: Cached respiratory-virus, AQHI/smoke, school-calendar, and pediatric-population context are adding small explicit lifts to demand and access forecasts.
interpretations.review_action: Validate source refresh cadence, missingness, regional mapping, and whether the lift coefficients should be site-specific before any production use.
interpretations.confidence_reason: Public sources are conceptually credible, but local calibration and denominator ownership are pending.
interpretations.next_step: Keep source badges visible and compare model performance with and without open-context features.

roleGuidance.value_question: Where is the pediatric system exposed, what is driving it, and which trade-offs need executive attention?
roleGuidance.primary_view: Network posture, site comparison, resource pressure, open-context trend, implementation-readiness exceptions.
roleGuidance.math_note: Uses the same source metrics as every persona; only aggregation, language, and action framing change.
roleGuidance.recommended_actions: Compare site posture, ask whether resource ceilings are constraining feasible actions, and sponsor governance decisions that unblock trusted signals.

roleGuidance.value_question: Which site objects need a huddle decision today and which scenario is feasible?
roleGuidance.primary_view: Site/unit/program objects, warnings, scenario feasibility, HR and finance constraints.
roleGuidance.math_note: Site filters preserve the same formulas and coefficients while narrowing object scope.
roleGuidance.recommended_actions: Review high-pressure units/programs, validate action feasibility, and capture scenario decisions for follow-up.

roleGuidance.value_question: What is blocking progression and where would action create the most effective capacity?
roleGuidance.primary_view: Unit heatmap, ED-to-inpatient flow, discharge funnel, predicted admits/discharges, affected units.
roleGuidance.math_note: Flow interpretation emphasizes capacity, boarders, transfers, and discharge barriers without changing calculation logic.
roleGuidance.recommended_actions: Open unit drawers, compare barriers and transfers, and use scenario lab to test discharge or step-down levers.

roleGuidance.value_question: What is changing on my unit and what review would be reasonable this shift?
roleGuidance.primary_view: Unit drawer, staffing gap, effective beds, warnings, discharge barriers, source lineage.
roleGuidance.math_note: Unit view uses direct unit-level rows where available and avoids changing thresholds by role.
roleGuidance.recommended_actions: Review HR/allied gaps, discharge blockers, transfer requests, and source confidence before escalating.

roleGuidance.value_question: Where are referrals, waitlist, diagnostics, templates, and follow-up becoming unsafe operational pressure?
roleGuidance.primary_view: Program object drawer, TNA, urgent waitlist, template gaps, diagnostics readiness, virtual/outreach scenario.
roleGuidance.math_note: Program calculations use the same waitlist, referral, and capacity formulas across roles.
roleGuidance.recommended_actions: Review urgent-slot protection, diagnostics readiness, and provider/allied-health capacity constraints.

roleGuidance.value_question: Which templates, no-shows, diagnostics, and follow-up queues need operational tuning?
roleGuidance.primary_view: Access heatmap, no-show frontier, provider capacity, diagnostics bars, program drawers.
roleGuidance.math_note: Clinic lens changes emphasis from strategic backlog to template mechanics, not the underlying math.
roleGuidance.recommended_actions: Compare template gap, no-show opportunity, and diagnostics readiness before changing clinic supply.

roleGuidance.value_question: Can each signal be trusted, implemented, governed, monitored, and retired safely?
roleGuidance.primary_view: Data & Model Readiness, model cards, coefficient registry, validation/drift, dependency graph, source badges.
roleGuidance.math_note: Technical persona exposes formulas, coefficients, thresholds, feature families, validation status, and dependencies.
roleGuidance.recommended_actions: Resolve blocked feeds, review metric definitions, validate coefficients, and maintain rollback/governance evidence.

signalSimulations.label: Triage and LOS orchestration
signalSimulations.inspiration: Frontier LOS orchestration and ED triage queueing methods
signalSimulations.clinical_boundary: Operational flow support only; does not replace triage, assessment, or physician judgement.
signalSimulations.target_question: Which arrivals are likely to consume constrained downstream capacity, and what operational constraint is driving the queue?
signalSimulations.cohort: Synthetic pediatric ED arrivals and admitted-boarder aggregates; no direct personal identifiers.
signalSimulations.threshold_logic: Watch when predicted LOS exceeds service-adjusted 80th percentile; high when boarding risk and downstream capacity constraint align.
signalSimulations.validation_status: synthetic silent replay only; real temporal validation pending
signalSimulations.model_family: survival/gradient boosting plus queueing constraint overlay
signalSimulations.feature_families: arrival pattern, CTAS-style acuity band, bed capacity, consult bottleneck, diagnostics turnaround, staffing, transfer pressure, open context
signalSimulations.so_what: The signal separates arrival pressure from downstream bed and consult constraints so teams can decide whether the bottleneck is triage room, diagnostics, consult, bed, transport, or staffing capacity.
signalSimulations.now_what: Review the top constrained factor, compare a step-down/discharge scenario, and capture whether the queue actually improved after the huddle window.
implementation_steps: Define cohort and exclusion criteria without identifiers.
Map curated aggregate fields through governed Snowflake views.
Backtest silently with temporal validation and subgroup review.
Review alert burden, false-positive impact, and human-factors risk.
Approve release gate, owner, rollback trigger, and learning writeback.

signalSimulations.label: Rare-disease case finding
signalSimulations.inspiration: ThinkRare-style phenotype patterning and pediatric rare-disease diagnostic support
signalSimulations.clinical_boundary: Case-finding queue only; no diagnosis, no automated referral, and no display of patient identifiers.
signalSimulations.target_question: Which aggregate synthetic phenotype patterns might warrant specialist review of a cohort, pathway, or referral delay?
signalSimulations.cohort: Synthetic de-identified feature bundles only; excludes direct chart or personal identifiers.
signalSimulations.threshold_logic: Watch when phenotype burden, diagnostic odyssey duration, and repeated specialty touchpoints align; high requires human genetics/specialist review queue approval.
signalSimulations.validation_status: prototype-only; requires precision, bias, referral-burden, and specialist review validation
signalSimulations.governance_status: blocked for real data until clinical governance and family-impact review
signalSimulations.model_family: phenotype embedding similarity plus rules-based pathway delay features
signalSimulations.feature_families: problem clusters, repeated referrals, abnormal-result families, growth/development proxies, medication class patterns, family history proxy flags, utilization path length
signalSimulations.so_what: This is a pathway-learning tool: it asks whether patterns of delay and repeated touchpoints indicate a cohort that deserves specialist review, not whether a child has a specific disease.
signalSimulations.now_what: Route only aggregate candidates to a governed review queue, measure false-positive burden, and tune thresholds with specialists before any live signal.
implementation_steps: Define cohort and exclusion criteria without identifiers.
Map curated aggregate fields through governed Snowflake views.
Backtest silently with temporal validation and subgroup review.
Review alert burden, false-positive impact, and human-factors risk.
Approve release gate, owner, rollback trigger, and learning writeback.

signalSimulations.label: General deterioration early warning
signalSimulations.inspiration: Pediatric early warning and deterioration-risk surveillance methods
signalSimulations.clinical_boundary: Synthetic surveillance rehearsal only; not a bedside alarm, diagnosis, or treatment recommendation.
signalSimulations.target_question: Where might aggregate deterioration-risk signals, staffing pressure, and workload context align enough to warrant review of monitoring reliability?
signalSimulations.cohort: Synthetic unit-level surveillance aggregates and score-band proxies; no identifiable child-level display.
signalSimulations.threshold_logic: Watch when score-band trend, respiratory support escalation, abnormal observation burden, and staffing gap align; high requires clinical safety review before display.
signalSimulations.validation_status: synthetic calibration only; real subgroup calibration and alert-burden review blocked
signalSimulations.model_family: calibrated logistic/gradient boosting risk with alert-burden governor
signalSimulations.feature_families: vital-sign completeness, respiratory support, abnormal score bands, escalation events, workload acuity, staffing gap, unit context
signalSimulations.so_what: The prototype demonstrates how safety surveillance must sit beside capacity and workload context so leaders can separate signal quality from staffing strain and alert burden.
signalSimulations.now_what: Run silent mode first, compare with existing escalation workflows, review false-positive burden, and require clinical safety approval before any alert display.
implementation_steps: Define cohort and exclusion criteria without identifiers.
Map curated aggregate fields through governed Snowflake views.
Backtest silently with temporal validation and subgroup review.
Review alert burden, false-positive impact, and human-factors risk.
Approve release gate, owner, rollback trigger, and learning writeback.

signalSimulations.label: NEC recognition rehearsal
signalSimulations.inspiration: Necrotizing enterocolitis early-recognition risk modelling and neonatal deterioration surveillance
signalSimulations.clinical_boundary: Prototype-only neonatal surveillance rehearsal; not diagnostic, not an alarm, and not validated for care decisions.
signalSimulations.target_question: Can a governed aggregate signal show how feeding, prematurity, infection/inflammation, vitals, labs, and imaging readiness might combine for NEC review?
signalSimulations.cohort: Synthetic NICU aggregate feature windows; no infant identifiers, free-text extraction, names, direct dates, or bedside instructions.
signalSimulations.threshold_logic: Watch when feeding intolerance proxy, inflammatory/lab family, abdominal imaging readiness, and prematurity context align; high remains blocked until neonatal safety review.
signalSimulations.validation_status: prototype-only; requires neonatal cohort definition, temporal leakage review, and silent validation
signalSimulations.model_family: time-windowed logistic/gradient boosting ensemble with leakage guardrails
signalSimulations.feature_families: gestational-age proxy, feeding trajectory, abdominal symptom proxy, lab/inflammation family, antibiotic/order family, imaging readiness, respiratory support, unit workload
signalSimulations.so_what: NEC is exactly the kind of high-stakes signal that should be shown as implementation design first: transparent variables, leakage guardrails, governance blocks, and no automated clinical instruction.
signalSimulations.now_what: Define neonatal cohort windows, run silent validation, require neonatal clinical-safety review, and track whether any signal would have added useful review time without unsafe alert burden.
implementation_steps: Define cohort and exclusion criteria without identifiers.
Map curated aggregate fields through governed Snowflake views.
Backtest silently with temporal validation and subgroup review.
Review alert burden, false-positive impact, and human-factors risk.
Approve release gate, owner, rollback trigger, and learning writeback.

escalationLanes.trigger: Boarders, effective-bed loss, or transfer pressure exceeds watch threshold.
escalationLanes.next_action: confirm bed plan, discharge barrier owner, and transport constraint

escalationLanes.trigger: Role-group gap threatens effective capacity or scenario feasibility.
escalationLanes.next_action: confirm skill mix, float-pool fit, overtime risk, and redeployment limit
decide whether resource ceiling is real constraint, deferrable work, or sponsor decision

escalationLanes.trigger: High-stakes AI or safety signal lacks validation evidence.
escalationLanes.next_action: hold display, run silent review, validate subgroup performance, confirm rollback

escalationLanes.trigger: Feed, metric definition, timestamp, or small-cell suppression check fails.
escalationLanes.next_action: repair curated view, document owner, rerun validation, update readiness badge

productionRunway.next_step: Define read-only curated Snowflake views, grains, freshness SLAs, small-cell rules, and source-owner signoff.
productionRunway.implementation_artifact: source contracts, access controls, quality checks
productionRunway.exit_criteria: Every source feeding command packets has owner, grain, fields, cadence, and validation evidence.

productionRunway.next_step: Build ADT/bed, ED boarding, discharge, ambulatory access, HR aggregate, finance-resource, and open-context marts.
productionRunway.exit_criteria: Metrics can be recalculated from marts without app-specific joins.

productionRunway.next_step: Approve denominators, coefficient provenance, scenario assumptions, and model-card evidence.
productionRunway.exit_criteria: Every major number has definition, owner, lineage, and validation state.

productionRunway.next_step: Run signals silently beside existing huddles, compare actions, assess false positives, subgroup performance, and alert burden.
productionRunway.exit_criteria: Signals improve review quality without unsafe burden or hidden inequity.

productionRunway.next_step: Pilot command packets in one site/service lane with acknowledgement, owner, action, outcome, and learning writeback.
productionRunway.exit_criteria: Packet review, action, follow-up, and learning can be audited end to end.

productionRunway.next_step: Scale only after rollback, monitoring, role training, incident response, and retire/spread rules are approved.
productionRunway.implementation_artifact: release gate, rollback plan, monitoring dashboard
productionRunway.exit_criteria: The operating layer can add, change, pause, or retire signals safely.
